subject: Crew arrival, camera rig clearance & operator handoff for Oct 14 workshop
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@harborvenues.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Crew arrival, camera rig clearance & operator handoff for Oct 14 workshop

Hi Kevin —

We’re locking logistics for the Oct 14 exec workshop (ACME). Two quick things we need to confirm so we can finalize travel and the vendor manifest:

- Ceiling / rigging: we plan a two-camera truss (approx 12 ft tall footprint with outriggers). Can the main boardroom support rig points or a free-standing truss? If not, what ceiling clearance do you have for the rooms on Level 2?
- AV operator & network: we need an experienced operator for the stream plus a dedicated VLAN or isolated upstream for the RTMP/Zoom bridge. Will your house operators support a feed handoff, or do we need to provision a separate contractor?

Please attach the Level 2 floorplan and any camera rig specs you have. Also call out loading-dock windows so we can coordinate the crew arrival and rentals truck.

Thanks — aiming to finalize vendor travel this week.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Events Lead, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0117
From: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@harborvenues.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: ops@harborvenues.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crew arrival, camera rig clearance & operator handoff for Oct 14 workshop

Thanks Sergio — quick answers and attachments below.

- Room A (Main Boardroom, Level 2) has an exposed ceiling with a clearance of 9.5 ft from finished floor to lowest beam. That means a 12 ft truss will not fit safely without structural rigging approval (which takes 2–3 weeks).
- Room C (adjacent, used as breakout normally) has a 14 ft ceiling and direct access to the network closet on the north wall — suitable for camera truss and permanent mounts.
- Our house AV team can handle house mixing and a feed handoff to your stream engineer. For dedicated streaming encoding we recommend using your contractor; we’ll provide a clean feed and VLAN.
- Loading dock: Oct 14 slot available 06:00–08:00 for vendor load-in. Please submit crew manifest and insurance certificate 7 days prior.

Attachments: (attachment: floorplan_level2.pdf, 1.2MB) (attachment: crew_manifest.csv)

If you want Room C held off for you, I can tentatively block it today — price difference for Room C + truss rigging permit is $1,200 (one-time).

Best,
Kevin Liu
Venue Operations Manager
Harbor Venues
kevin.liu@harborvenues.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@harborvenues.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crew arrival, camera rig clearance & operator handoff for Oct 14 workshop

Noted — Room A ceiling is too low for our planned truss. Room C sounds fine but two quick asks before I approve: 

- Dylan: can you confirm the total crew headcount we need to submit for union/venue access? I estimate 4 techs + 1 stagehand + 1 streamer engineer.
- Logistics: we need a plan for where rental trucks park during the 06:00–08:00 window (Kevin, is the dock single-bay or can two trucks stage?).

If Room C is available, I’m OK with the $1,200 permit assuming we can keep within our ops budget — I’ll route the approval if Dylan confirms gear list.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@harborvenues.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crew arrival, camera rig clearance & operator handoff for Oct 14 workshop

Marissa — quick inventory and recommendation: 

- Inventory we’re bringing: 2x SONY cameras (NXCAM series), 2x streaming encoders, 2 Sennheiser wireless receivers + 6 lav mics, 3 wired handhelds, 1 audio snake (16 ch).
- Crew: 3 video techs (setup, camera ops, encode), 2 audio techs (mix + stage), 1 stagehand = 6 total.
- I recommend we bring our streaming engineer for the RTMP bridge; ask venue to provide the house operator for FOH/house mix only. That minimizes cross-operator handoff risk and keeps our latency profile tighter.

Please hold Room C and the 06:00–08:00 dock slot until we confirm manifest. I’ll prepare the crew_manifest.csv and upload the insurance cert today. Also drafting a short operator handoff checklist (power & IPs, patch list, mic check timeline) and will share by EOD.

—
Dylan Brooks
Lead Broadcast Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@harborvenues.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crew arrival, camera rig clearance & operator handoff for Oct 14 workshop

All —

Room C is tentatively reserved for Redwood on Oct 14. Please note the following action items / constraints: 

- Load-in: 10/14, 06:00–08:00 (single-bay dock; second truck can stage on curb for quick unload; coordinate with security at arrival).
- Union/Access: venue requires full crew manifest plus insurance docs 7 days prior to event (submit by 10/07).
- Camera rig: attaching the truss spec for your vendor review. Structural permit fee (one-time) as quoted before. (attachment: camera_rig_spec.xlsx)
- Operator handoff: we’ll do a 30-minute pre-event walk at 08:15 with your stream engineer and our house operator. Venue will provide two comms headsets for the house operator; bring feed point adapters (BNC/SDI/ethernet).

Please return the completed crew_manifest.csv and a PDF of your insurance policy. Once we have it we’ll finalize the dock reservation and badge access.

Kevin
From: Allison Park <allison.park@acme.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@harborvenues.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crew arrival, camera rig clearance & operator handoff for Oct 14 workshop

Thanks team — appreciate the update. A few items from ACME: 

- Can we get a dedicated green room for two speakers and a private assistant area? Ideally adjacent to Room C.
- Catering: please order two vegetarian and one gluten-free boxed lunch for speakers; attendee catering otherwise will be standard.
- Mic check: can we schedule an attendee mic check and name-plate run at 09:15 so speakers can test mics before the 09:30 start?

If the venue can confirm green room and mic check slot, we’re good on our side. Looking forward to the operator handoff checklist (Dylan).

Best,
Allison Park
Product Lead, ACME Corp
allison.park@acme.com
